body:
Next native Serenity slice: Bliss composite5 closest-velocity TAA.

SerenityTemporal now takes velocity from the nearest of 5 depth taps (2-pixel corners + center), applies that velocity to the center UV (not the neighbor's UV), Catmull-Rom fetches history, dual AABB clamps, and Reinhard-mixes with extra blend when the clamp rejects history. Same previous/inv view-projection as before. Iris entity velocity attributes are still not a thing here.

Still gaps: voxel LPV, layered cloud shadow maps, water volume refraction, persistent scene-linear brightness texel. Forge not touched.
